title: gentianella polymorpha
intro: Gentianella polymorpha, commonly known as small gentian, is a perennial flowering plant belonging to the Gentianaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its health benefits such as improving digestion and reducing fever. The therapeutic actions of Gentianella polymorpha include stimulating the digestive system, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
